name: @dot-brain/platform-collector
description: Hourly collector: fetches each enrolled platform's dot-guardian/v1 health document and records one observation per platform to Dot.Memory, so Brain's picture of the live platforms is refreshed hourly. Records only; never remediates (that is Guardian). See ../../docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-hourly-platform-collection-design.md.
